! device: sw-arista-01 (DCS-7050SX3-48YC8, EOS-4.29.2F)
!
hostname sw-arista-01
!
vlan 10
   name USERS
!
vlan 20
   name SERVERS
!
interface Ethernet1
   description to-core-01
   switchport mode trunk
   switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20
!
interface Ethernet2
   description to-server-01
   switchport access vlan 20
   spanning-tree portfast
   spanning-tree bpduguard enable
!
interface Vlan10
   ip address 10.0.10.1/24
!
interface Vlan20
   ip address 10.0.20.1/24
!
ip routing
!
ip route 0.0.0.0/0 10.0.10.254
ip route 10.9.0.0/16 10.0.20.254 200
!
router bgp 65001
   router-id 10.0.10.1
   neighbor 10.0.10.2 remote-as 65002
   neighbor 10.0.10.2 maximum-routes 30000
   neighbor 10.0.10.2 route-map RM-IN in
   neighbor 10.0.10.2 route-map RM-OUT out
   neighbor 10.0.10.2 password 7 xxxxx
   network 10.0.10.0/24
!
route-map RM-IN permit 10
   match ip address prefix-list PL-IN
!
route-map RM-OUT permit 10
   match ip address prefix-list PL-OUT
!
ip prefix-list PL-IN seq 10 permit 10.9.0.0/16
ip prefix-list PL-OUT seq 10 permit 10.0.10.0/24
!
management api http-commands
   no shutdown
!
